description: This Java class `ScriptLinkHelper` is a utility for managing external JavaScript references and inline scripts in web pages, particularly for handling content security policies and script caching per user session within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ScriptLinkHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods to manage script links and inline scripts, including caching scripts per user session, adding script links for page rendering, and cleaning up session-based caches.

methods.name: addScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Adds a script file URL to the set of scripts that will be included at the end of the HTML body.

methods.name: getScriptLinksForBodyEnd
methods.description: Retrieves the set of script URLs queued to be included at the bottom of the HTML page.

methods.name: putScriptInCache
methods.description: Stores inline script content in a session-scoped cache with a unique key, managing cache size limits.

methods.name: getScriptFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves and removes a cached inline script for a session based on filename.

methods.name: cleanupScriptCache
methods.description: Removes all cached scripts associated with a user session, called when session ends.

methods.name: prepareScriptLinkForBodyEnd
methods.description: Caches inline script content, generates a URL (possibly with CSRF token), and adds it to the script links to be included at page footer.
